name: Gibson Guitar Of The Week #7 Les Paul Money Bass 2007 - Midnight Manhattan Blue
description: In 2007 produced Gibson in Nashville over 48 weeks every week an instrument limited to 400 copies, which did not quite match the standard models. The Gibson Les Paul Double Cut Bass (Longscale/34 inches) was manufactured from 2006 to 2008, and as a special edition "Guitar Of The Week #7" there was the Les Paul Money Bass in Manhattan Midnight Blue with a figured maple top and a glossy finish.The massive mahogany body has the typical Les Paul shape and is similar to the LP Standard Bass, but with a double cutaway and a shaping on the upper body side; it weighs approximately 3.9 kg (personal scales).The 34" mahogany neck is glued in, and the rosewood fretboard has 24 frets, all of which are playable. The bass has two humbucker pickups and a passive electronics system without a switch, with two volume controls and a tone control.He is technically flawless, the frets are still top, also visually in a very good condition - except for the traces of a belt buckle on the back (from the previous owner) that have been pressed but not scratched into the lacquer and are only visible in reflective light (see photo). The protective film is still on the electronics cover.The bass comes in the original black Gibson case with white plush lining and the corresponding Gibson quality control card.This is a private sale of an used instrument, offered without any warranty / guarantee, therefore no exchange or return.

name: Taylor Guitars 4 Vets GS Mini Special Edition Acoustic Guitar, Desert Camo w/ Bag
description:
For every Special Edition Veterans GS Mini we sell, Taylor will donate 5% to Guitars 4 Vets!

For years, Taylor’s partnership with Guitars 4 Vets has helped make music a tool for healing veterans affected by PTSD and other service-related trauma. They’re proud to continue that mission with the Guitars 4 Vets GS Mini Camo Special Edition—an exclusive custom design that visually honors America’s veterans. With its compact dimensions, the GS Mini is perfect for travel, casual practice, campfire jams or songwriting sessions. The easy-playing Taylor neck makes it a great choice for players of any skill level, while the solid torrefied Sitka spruce top delivers a bold, dynamic voice. This special-edition model features custom artwork, Italian acrylic dot inlays, chrome tuners and a matte finish on the body and neck. It ships with a structured gig bag featuring built-in backpack straps for easy portability.
Featuring a custom camouflage top design, this special-edition GS Mini helps support Guitars 4 Vets' mission to use music as a tool for healing from service-related trauma. The GS Mini Special Edition Guitars 4 Vets Camo serves up a clear, bold sound with volume and projection that punch far above its scaled-back size, with a touch of aged-in warmth and sweetness thanks to our proprietary torrefaction process for the solid spruce top. A slender neck profile with a narrower nut width of 1-11/16" ensures smooth, relaxed fretting, while the compact body dimensions offer an accommodating, travel-friendly feel that's perfect for everything from campfire jams to practice sessions at home. Visual details complementing the custom camo top include faux-pearl 4mm dot fretboard inlays, chrome tuning machines, a black pickguard, a matte finish and an exclusive Guitars 4 Vets interior label.
The GS Mini Special Edition features a scaled-down version of Taylor's popular Grand Symphony body shape. With a 23.5-inch scale and a total length of just over 36 inches, the GS Mini is a perfect travel companion for road trips, flights, and other excursions. Though more compact than a traditional GS model, the GS Mini Special Edition provides a full-scale sound with rich harmonics, lush tones, and confident projection.

A special collaboration between Taylor and G4V that honors military veterans and their service
Torrefied Sitka spruce top offers timeless tone, enhanced acoustic qualities, and added top strength
Layered sapele back and sides complement the Sitka top with a full-bodied warmth
X-braced soundhole contributes to the balanced tone, superb clarity, and ample projection — unmatched in this size range
Neo-tropical mahogany neck with a standard carve and smooth ebony fingerboard provides agile movement along the guitar's register
Short 23.5-in. scale length makes this guitar the perfect road companion
Custom camo artwork incorporates a sepia-hued aesthetic with a subtle edgeburst fade
A portion of the proceeds from every GS Mini Desert Camo Special Edition support G4V’s initiatives for US veterans
